Of Altenstadt, Bas-Rhin. Married Maria Elizabetha Aschbacher in 1785; Barbe, born 1806,
was the thirteenth of their children. Died 1807.
Born at Altenstadt in 1761, daughter of Johannis Aschbacher and Marie Barbe Vetter,
from families settled around Wissembourg since the late 1600s.
She married Martin Noullet; their daughter Barbe was born in 1806.
